title: Clinton and Obama both deny anything underground at Area 51
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Clinton and Obama both deny anything underground at Area 51, about 1990s-present at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What a weird thing to say about it. They both said, yeah, there's nothing underground at Area 51.

plain: A researcher named Jason Simosa, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about Area 51, a secret US military base in the Nevada desert long tied to UFO stories. He says that two former presidents, Bill Clinton and Barack Obama, both said there is nothing underground at Area 51, and he finds it a weird thing for them to say, as if the denial itself hints at something hidden.
